theme: 教材字彙・中高階 750–850 第 60 群

items.colloc: repeatedly warn 一再警告 | repeatedly mention 反覆提及
items.distinct: frequently 經常 | constantly 不斷地
ex: The client has repeatedly requested a discount.
客戶已多次要求折扣。
He was repeatedly told to finish the report.
他被多次告知要完成報告。
The software crashed repeatedly during the demo.
軟體在展示期間多次當機。

items.colloc: resist the urge 忍住衝動 | resist pressure 抵抗壓力
items.distinct: withstand 禁得起 | endure 忍受
ex: Management could not resist the market demand.
管理層無法抵擋市場需求。
She could not resist checking her emails tonight.
她今晚忍不住查看郵件。
Employees often resist changes in company policy.
員工常對公司政策變動感到抗拒。

items.colloc: early retirement 提早退休 | retirement plan 退休計畫
items.distinct: pension 退休金 | resignation 辭職
ex: Mr. Chen is planning his early retirement.
陳先生正在規劃提早退休。
The company offers a comprehensive retirement plan.
該公司提供完善的退休計畫。
She saved enough money for her retirement.
她為退休生活存了足夠的錢。

items.colloc: peer reviewer 同儕審查員 | book reviewer 書評家
items.distinct: editor 編輯 | critic 批評家
ex: The reviewer gave the new product high marks.
審查員給予這項新產品高分評價。
He works as a reviewer for a tech journal.
他在一份科技期刊擔任評論員。
The manuscript was sent to an anonymous reviewer.
手稿被寄給了一位匿名審查員。

items.colloc: ridiculous idea 荒謬的主意 | ridiculous price 離譜的價格
items.distinct: absurd 荒唐的 | silly 傻氣的
ex: It is ridiculous to charge such high fees.
收取這麼高的費用真是荒謬。
His proposal for the budget seems quite ridiculous.
他提出的預算方案看起來相當荒謬。
The meeting time was set at a ridiculous hour.
會議時間被定在一個離譜的時段。

items.colloc: roughly estimated 大約估計 | roughly speaking 大致來說
items.distinct: approximately 大約 | strictly 嚴格地
ex: The project will take roughly three months.
這個專案大約需要三個月完成。
Our office is located roughly two miles away.
我們的辦公室距離大約兩英里。
Roughly forty people attended the annual seminar.
大約有四十人參加了年度研討會。

items.pos: adj. 精選的；挑選過的 | v. 挑選
items.colloc: selected items 精選商品 | selected group 特定小組
items.distinct: chosen 選擇的 | elected 選舉產生的
ex: We only use selected materials for production.
我們只使用精選的材料進行生產。
The selected candidates will receive an email.
獲選的候選人將會收到電子郵件。
He selected the best designs for the exhibit.
他挑選了最好的設計作品展出。

items.colloc: several factors 幾個因素 | several times 好幾次
items.distinct: some 一些 | many 許多
ex: There are several issues with the current plan.
目前的計畫有幾個問題。
I have contacted several suppliers this morning.
我今天早上聯絡了幾家供應商。
Several members of the team were absent.
該團隊有好幾位成員缺席。

items.colloc: spoil the plan 破壞計畫 | spoil the mood 掃興
items.distinct: damage 損害 | ruin 毀滅
ex: Heavy rain might spoil our outdoor event.
大雨可能會搞砸我們的戶外活動。
Don't let a minor mistake spoil your work.
不要讓小錯誤影響你的工作表現。
If the food is left out, it will spoil.
如果食物放在外面，很快就會變質。

items.pos: adv. 仍然；還是 | adj. 靜止的
items.colloc: still waiting 仍在等待 | still effective 仍然有效
items.distinct: yet 還沒 | quiet 安靜的
ex: The company is still hiring for the position.
公司目前仍在招募這個職位。
He is still working on the final report.
他還在處理最後的報告。
The market is still recovering from the crisis.
市場仍在從危機中復甦。

items.pos: adv. 確實地；毫無疑問地
items.colloc: surely expect 確實期待 | surely know 肯定知道
items.distinct: certainly 當然地 | definitely 肯定地
ex: This new policy will surely increase productivity.
這項新政策肯定會提高生產力。
You can surely find the answer in the manual.
你絕對可以在手冊中找到答案。
The success of the project will surely lead to growth.
專案的成功肯定會帶來成長。

items.pos: n. 驚喜；驚訝 | v. 使驚訝
items.colloc: surprise visit 突擊訪問 | pleasant surprise 意外驚喜
items.distinct: shock 震驚 | wonder 驚奇
ex: The results came as a surprise to us all.
結果對我們所有人來說都是個驚喜。
Her resignation surprised the entire department.
她的辭職讓整個部門感到驚訝。
We prepared a small surprise for his birthday.
我們為他的生日準備了一個小驚喜。

items.colloc: surround the building 圍繞建築 | be surrounded by 被環繞
items.distinct: encircle 圈住 | enclose 封入
ex: The park is surrounded by several office buildings.
這座公園被幾棟辦公大樓環繞。
We need to surround ourselves with talented people.
我們需要聚集優秀的人才在身邊。
Trees surround the factory to reduce the noise.
工廠周圍種植樹木以降低噪音。

items.colloc: themed party 主題派對 | themed restaurant 主題餐廳
items.distinct: thematic 主題的 | typical 典型的
ex: The event featured a winter-themed decoration.
活動以冬季為主題進行裝飾。
This hotel offers various themed guest rooms.
這家飯店提供各式各樣的主題客房。
They organized a travel-themed marketing campaign.
他們組織了一場以旅遊為主題的行銷活動。

items.colloc: thickly populated 人口稠密的 | thickly coated 厚塗的
items.distinct: densely 密集地 | heavily 沉重地
ex: The walls were thickly painted in white.
牆壁被厚厚地漆成了白色。
The area is thickly populated with many businesses.
該地區商業活動非常密集。
The butter was spread thickly on the bread.
奶油厚厚地塗在麵包上。

items.pos: v. 威脅；恐嚇；預示（壞事）
items.colloc: threaten to resign 威脅要辭職 | threaten the stability 威脅穩定
items.distinct: intimidate 脅迫 | warn 警告
ex: Falling sales threaten the company's future.
營收下滑威脅到公司的未來。
He threatened to quit if demands were not met.
他威脅若需求未被滿足就要辭職。
Heavy pollution threatens the local environment.
嚴重汙染正威脅著當地環境。

items.colloc: translate into 翻譯成 | translate documents 翻譯文件
items.distinct: interpret 口譯 | convert 轉換
ex: Please translate this contract into English.
請把這份合約翻譯成英文。
His hard work translated into great success.
他的努力轉化成了巨大的成功。
We need someone to translate the meeting notes.
我們需要有人翻譯會議記錄。

items.pos: v. 使用；利用 | n. 用途；用法
items.colloc: make use of 利用 | common use 常見用途
items.distinct: utilize 利用（正式）| employ 雇用；使用
ex: Did you use the new software for the data?
你用這套新軟體處理資料了嗎？
There is no use complaining about the results.
抱怨結果是沒有用的。
We use this machine for cutting the metal.
我們使用這台機器來切割金屬。

items.colloc: visible result 明顯的成果 | highly visible 高度可見的
items.distinct: noticeable 顯眼的 | obvious 顯然的
ex: The brand logo is visible on the package.
包裝上可以看到品牌標誌。
There was no visible improvement in his work.
他的工作沒有明顯的改善。
The mountain is visible from our office window.
從我們的辦公室窗戶可以看到那座山。

items.pos: v. 想知道；納悶 | n. 奇蹟；驚奇
items.colloc: wonder if 想知道是否 | wonder about 對...感到好奇
items.distinct: wander 漫遊 | admire 欣賞
ex: I wonder if the meeting has been postponed.
我納悶會議是否已經延後了。
We wonder how to improve the current process.
我們想知道如何改善目前的流程。
It is a wonder that the project was finished.
這個專案能完成真是一個奇蹟。
